Settings.title: Settings
Settings.description: Company details, contacts, the receiving account, booking rules and homepage content. Each section is saved on its own.
Settings.policiesDescription: Refund tiers by days before departure are managed on their own page.

company.title: Company and legal
company.description: Shown in the footer: brand, legal entity, tax code, tour operator licence and e-commerce notification.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Hotline, email and chat channels for the floating contact button and the footer.

social.title: Social media
social.description: https:// links to the brand's profiles. Leave empty to hide.

bank_account.title: Receiving account
bank_account.description: Used for VietQR codes when customers pay by transfer (Phase 4). Never public.

booking_rules.title: Booking rules
booking_rules.description: Seat hold times, balance reminders and the booking cutoff before departure.

homepage.title: Homepage
homepage.description: Headline, background image and featured destinations. The homepage sections are fixed in code.

fields.name: Brand name
fields.tax_codeHint: 10 digits, or 13 with a branch suffix (0101234567-001).
fields.ecommerce_notification_url: Ministry of Industry and Trade notification link
fields.bank_binHint: 6 digits from NAPAS, e.g. 970436 for Vietcombank.
fields.account_holderHint: Upper case without diacritics, exactly as the bank shows it.
fields.reminders: Balance reminders (days before the due date)
fields.remindersHint: Up to 5, separated by commas, e.g. 7, 2.
fields.cutoffDaysHint: 0–60 days. Closer departures no longer take online bookings.
fields.featuredHint: Up to 6 published countries or regions.

errors.httpsOnly: The link must start with https://.
errors.taxCodeInvalid: A tax code is 10 digits, or 10 digits, a hyphen and 3 digits.
errors.accountNumberInvalid: An account number is 4–30 letters or digits.
errors.heroAltMissing: Images on the homepage need Vietnamese and English alt text. Add them in the media library.
errors.unknownDestination: Only published destinations can be picked.
errors.failed: Could not save. Please try again.
